title: Clients the KRAs report as deceased (NSE ENIT)
purpose: The file <TMcode>_Demise_Clients_by_KRA on NSE's member portal (enit.nseindia.com > ENIT > Log > Downloads): PANs of the firm's clients that the KRAs report as deceased up to the date in that month's circular. NSE does not publish the columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when NSE's differs). A file with no header row is read as PAN, then client code.
linked: Matched by PAN (and client code) on Compliance → Deceased clients: debits are blocked at once and the steps to the UCC closure and transmission are tracked against the month's cut-off.
source: NSE/ISC/77375 (9 Nov 2026) and NSE/ISC/76893 (14 Oct 2026): the file <TMcode>_Demise_Clients_by_KRA at https://enit.nseindia.com/MemberPortal/ > ENIT > Log > Downloads; neither gives its columns, so they are read by header names.
